Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the chat this morning. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we can get your eval started smoothly: 

Recap:
- Primary use case: in-product assistant for customer support triage and knowledge retrieval (short responses, consistent tone).
- Key constraints: 95th pct latency < 600ms for single-turn queries, PII redaction requirement, and support for Spanish/English prompt sets.
- Success criteria for the eval: precision on top-1 answer >= 85% on your curated prompt set, average token cost under $0.003 per token for typical sessions, and no PII leakage in test prompts.

Proposed next step: 60-minute evaluation kickoff (trial plan, success criteria walk-through, prompt set & baseline evals). Connor (cc'd) will join for the technical portion.

Two slots that work for us next week — pick one that fits your calendar:
- Tue, Mar 23, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu, Mar 25, 09:00–10:00 PT

Attached: redwood-eval-scope.pdf (high-level kickoff agenda & trial plan).
